reasoning: 驗證目標：HU 於 Interior CAN 上喚醒時，召回 speed controlled volume 之狀態（CFTS022-4915168）。關鍵情境條件：先把 SCV 設為非預設狀態，睡眠後以 Interior CAN 喚醒 HU。為什麼這樣切：本條與兄弟 leaf -004 觸發條件不同、驗證面也不同，不得合併 —— 本條之觸發為 wakes up on Interior CAN（明文限定 Interior CAN），驗的是內部狀態之召回；-004 之觸發為 wakes up（未限定介面），驗的是對外訊號之傳送。兩者照條文原樣寫，不互相補齊。刻意略過：SCV 隨車速調整音量之行為本身不在本條範圍，本條只驗喚醒後狀態被召回這一層。該排除有外部 spec 之歸屬佐證（B1 review N1，執行層獨立複驗）：CFTS022-4915171 與 SYSAD 之 SYS-RA-PROF-172 兩處各有同一 Note ——「See {VF651} for the AMP present configuration requirements and {CFTS019} for speed controlled audio behavior requirements」，即「隨車速調整之音訊行為」由 CFTS019 擁有。依 §8.4.2（僅定義於外部 spec 者out of scope，歸該 spec 之 owner）排除成立。**該 Note 掛在 PROF-172（leaf -006）而非本葉**：-003 自身之條文 4915168 無此 Note，故該佐證為「該行為之歸屬」之一般性陳述，非本葉條文之自帶限定。

distinguishing_axis.delta: -003 驗喚醒後之內部狀態召回（recall）；-004 驗喚醒後之對外訊號傳送（send）

tcs.tc_title: Speed controlled volume state is recalled when the HU wakes up on Interior CAN
tcs.test_item: When the HU wakes up on Interior CAN, the HU shall recall the state of the speed controlled volume
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The speed controlled volume is set to a state other than its default state
2. The HU is asleep
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Record the state of the speed controlled volume
2. Trigger the wake-up of the HU on Interior CAN
3. Read the state of the speed controlled volume on the HU
4. Set the speed controlled volume to a state other than the one recorded in step 1
5. Trigger the HU to sleep
6. Trigger the wake-up of the HU on Interior CAN
7. Read the state of the speed controlled volume on the HU
tcs.expected_result:
1. The state of the speed controlled volume is recorded
2. The HU is awake
3. The speed controlled volume is in the state recorded in step 1
4. The speed controlled volume is in the state set in step 4
5. The HU is asleep
6. The HU is awake
7. The speed controlled volume is in the state set in step 4
